businesses.business: clinical diagnostics and life science tools

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures diagnostic instruments, reagents and quality controls for clinical laboratories. It also supplies life science instruments and consumables to research laboratories and biopharmaceutical companies.

primary_products.value: clinical diagnostic analyzers and reagents; laboratory quality controls; PCR instruments and reagents; electrophoresis equipment and supplies; chromatography media and systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospital and reference laboratories, blood banks, universities and biopharmaceutical companies; B2G: Public health laboratories and government research institutes

end_markets.value: clinical laboratory diagnostics; blood banking; academic and government research; biopharmaceutical research and manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Laboratory instruments, reagents, quality controls and other consumables; service fees: Instrument maintenance and repair under service agreements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns components and chemical inputs into instruments and consumables for clinical and research laboratories; service provider: Maintains and repairs installed instruments for laboratory customers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Clinical diagnostics, laboratory quality control and life science research tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving clinical laboratories and research institutions; distributors / dealers: Independent laboratory equipment and reagent distributors; online: Company web store for laboratory supplies and consumables

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Clinical diagnostic devices subject to FDA oversight and EU in vitro diagnostic device requirements
